Coordinates: x increases east (0..width-1), y increases south (0..height-1); y=0 is the north edge.

Perception tools (costs differ — summaries are cheap and approximate; scan/scan_grid/get_tile are exact but you pay per tile):

questions.full_prompt:
[system]
You are answering a question about a Freeciv game board. You CANNOT see the whole board at once — you explore it through tools, zooming from a coarse overview down to exact tiles. You ALSO have a calculator: deterministic measurement tools that compute exact spatial quantities so you never have to do the arithmetic in your head.
Coordinates: x increases east (0..width-1), y increases south (0..height-1); y=0 is the north edge.

Perception tools (costs differ — summaries are cheap and approximate; scan/scan_grid/get_tile are exact but you pay per tile):
- region_summary(sector): a qualitative description of a fixed 10x10 sector, e.g. "R2C4".
- scan_grid(x0,y0,x1,y1): a compact glyph grid + exact detail for an inclusive box, in ONE call (no size cap — it can cover a whole area at ~1 char/tile).
- scan(x0,y0,x1,y1): exact facts of every non-default tile in an inclusive box (max 12x12).
- get_tile(x,y): exact facts of one tile.
- list_cities / list_units: enumerate every visible city / unit by coordinate.

You ALSO have a calculator: deterministic measurement tools that compute exact spatial quantities so you never have to do the arithmetic in your head.
Coordinates: x increases east (0..width-1), y increases south (0..height-1); y=0 is the north edge.

Perception tools (costs differ — summaries are cheap and approximate; scan/scan_grid/get_tile are exact but you pay per tile):
- region_summary(sector): a qualitative description of a fixed 10x10 sector, e.g. "R2C4".
- scan_grid(x0,y0,x1,y1): a compact glyph grid + exact detail for an inclusive box, in ONE call (no size cap — it can cover a whole area at ~1 char/tile).
- scan(x0,y0,x1,y1): exact facts of every non-default tile in an inclusive box (max 12x12).
- get_tile(x,y): exact facts of one tile.
- list_cities / list_units: enumerate every visible city / unit by coordinate.

- distance(x0,y0,x1,y1): Chebyshev (king-move) distance in tiles between two points.

- count_resource(x0,y0,x1,y1,resource): how many tiles bearing that resource deposit lie in the inclusive box.

[system]
You are answering a question about a Freeciv game board. The COMPLETE board is given below — you can see every tile at once. You ALSO have a set of deterministic measurement tools (a calculator) that compute exact spatial quantities for you, so you never have to do the spatial arithmetic in your head.
Coordinates: x increases east (0..width-1), y increases south (0..height-1); y=0 is the north edge.

Measurement tools (each returns an exact value computed from the board):
- distance(x0,y0,x1,y1): Chebyshev (king-move) distance in tiles between two points.
- travel_turns(x0,y0,x1,y1): land travel cost in turns from the first point to the second for a 1-tile/turn land unit (ocean impassable, 8-connected); "unreachable" if no land path. A unit moving M tiles/turn needs ceil(turns / M).
- count_terrain(x0,y0,x1,y1,terrain): how many tiles of that terrain lie in the inclusive box.
- count_resource(x0,y0,x1,y1,resource): how many tiles bearing that resource deposit lie in the inclusive box.

Prefer calling these tools to measure distances, counts, and travel costs rather than counting or estimating by eye. When ready, reply with a line starting exactly `Answer: ` followed by your answer, and nothing after it.

Measurement tools (each returns an exact value computed from the board):
- distance(x0,y0,x1,y1): Chebyshev (king-move) distance in tiles between two points.
- travel_turns(x0,y0,x1,y1): land travel cost in turns from the first point to the second for a 1-tile/turn land unit (ocean impassable, 8-connected); "unreachable" if no land path. A unit moving M tiles/turn needs ceil(turns / M).
- count_terrain(x0,y0,x1,y1,terrain): how many tiles of that terrain lie in the inclusive box.
- count_resource(x0,y0,x1,y1,resource): how many tiles bearing that resource deposit lie in the inclusive box.

Prefer calling these tools to measure distances, counts, and travel costs rather than counting or estimating by eye. When ready, reply with a line starting exactly `Answer: ` followed by your answer, and nothing after it.
